messages:
maya (AE): Sunflare asked for a compact perf validation. Needs: sustained 110 qps chat (total seq ~512), short bursts up to 750 qps, plus comparison redwood-7b-4bit vs redwood-7b-fp32. Also explicitly asked to show cache ON vs OFF impact and provide CI commands + redact proof. Can we scope a run and a ballpark cost?

rob (SRE): Plan: warm 20m (populate prefix KV cache), steady 45m @110 qps, bursts: 3m@250, 3m@500, 5m@750, cooldown 10m. We'll run 4 experiments: 4bit cold, 4bit warm, fp32 cold, fp32 warm. Metrics: p50/p95/p99/p99.9, gpu_util, batch_size_dist, kv_cache_hit. Tag runs customer=sunflare bench=mixed-cache.

jen (SE): Good. Cold runs should clear cache between experiments and use a different request seed. For warm runs pre-populate with ~8k representative prompts and verify cache hit ratio >=70%. We'll capture tail under both.

joe (Solutions Eng): Quick cost sketch: assume avg output 65 toks/resp. Token math: 110*65=7150 tok/s steady. Example list-rate token prices: fp32 $0.0000010/token, 4bit $0.00000036/token. For a full 6h test set, rough token compute cost: 4bit ~$1.6k, fp32 ~$5.2k (ballpark). I'll produce a small spreadsheet once runs confirmed.

ci-bot: job sunflare-bench-v1 queued (id: ci-sunflare-2025-02-08)

rob (SRE): Pasteable CI command for reproducibility:
```bash
./bench/run_bench.sh \ 
  --profile profiles/sunflare_cache_vs_no_cache.json \ 
  --model redwood-7b-4bit \ 
  --duration 3600 \ 
  --out gs://redwood-temp/sunflare/run-4bit-warm.json \ 
  --meta "customer=sunflare,trial=cache-warm" \ 
  --redact-prompts true
```
Note --redact-prompts stores only hashes+token counts. We'll upload profile and seed file.

rob (SRE): interim (4bit warm steady complete): steady 45m @110 qps done. p95 128ms, p99 305ms, p99.9 610ms. kv_cache_hit ~74%, gpu_util 60%, median batch 8. No drops. Partial upload: gs://redwood-temp/sunflare/interim-4bit-warm.json

jen (SE): Those numbers look solid for warm 4bit. Can we see cold 4bit next to understand variance?

rob (SRE): Running 4bit cold now (cache cleared between runs).

ci-bot: sunflare-bench-v1 runner applied temporary burst quota

rob (SRE): final (all runs complete). Topline summarized: 
- 4bit warm: steady p95 130ms, burst@750 p95 480ms, burst@750 p99.9 1.15s, kv_hit 72%
- 4bit cold: steady p95 210ms, burst@750 p95 950ms, burst@750 p99.9 2.1s, kv_hit 8%
- fp32 warm: steady p95 95ms, burst@750 p95 240ms, burst@750 p99.9 680ms, kv_hit 70%
- fp32 cold: steady p95 150ms, burst@750 p95 420ms, burst@750 p99.9 1.05s, kv_hit 5%
Cost delta observed in runs: fp32 ~3.0x per-token cost vs 4bit. Note: warm cache greatly reduces tail for both variants; cold cache amplifies tail for 4bit more. Artifacts & profiles uploaded: gs://redwood-temp/sunflare/final/ (redact manifest included).

jen (SE): Interpretation: If Sunflare can populate and keep prefix cache warm, 4bit is attractive cost-wise. For unpredictable cold-start bursts or stricter tail SLOs prefer fp32 on Dedicated or ensure pre-warm pipelines. Recommend routing policy: prefer 4bit for steady, automatically shift new burst requests to fp32 when p95 > 300ms for >15s.

joe (Solutions Eng): I'll produce the cost appendix with three scenarios (hosted list-rate, hosted w/commit, Dedicated). Also include an estimate of addon ops for KMS/HSM if they request it.

maya (AE): Great. Action items: rob confirm gs links and redact proof (owner), jen draft one-pager + recommendation, joe finalize cost sheet, maya prep customer deck. Need final deliverables by Wed 10am PT. Thanks team :thumbsup:
